lines.zh: 我一步一顿，尾巴扫着地。

lines.en: The blades on my shoulders catch light.

lines.zh: 我的手臂很粗，走起来晃。
lines.en: Thick arms, and I sway as I walk.
Red light moves over my body.

lines.zh: 恶地的红岩被我一踩就碎。
我停下来，尾巴打了个圈。
lines.en: I stop and loop my tail.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在石面上刮出白痕。
lines.en: My claws score the stone white.
I follow the heat up the ridge.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲撞到树就断了。
lines.en: Trees snap at my shoulder plates.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，可没人敢挡。
lines.en: I walk slowly, and none dare block me.
The ground warms where I step.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴撑了一下地面。

lines.en: Scorch marks follow me along the ridge.

lines.zh: 我站着，胸口的刃一直亮。
lines.en: I stand; the blade at my chest glows.
I listen to something very far away.

lines.zh: 我的护甲上全是被烧过的痕。
lines.en: My armor is scorched all over.
I open a hand and close it.

lines.zh: 红色的光在胳膊上来回走。
我的牙比你的手臂还长。
lines.en: My teeth are longer than your arm.

lines.zh: 我站在山脊上，等一个敢上来的。
lines.en: I stand on the ridge, waiting for someone brave enough.
I tilt my head a fraction.
Cold mountain wind. I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖肩膀，刃甲互相磨响。
lines.en: I shake my shoulders and the blade plates grind.
Soon I will let it out.
There is no fire in you.
I read you at a glance.
Can you take one wave of heat?

lines.zh: 我不是最快的，可我最热。

lines.en: No need to retreat. You will anyway.
This is close enough for me.
I raise a hand and fire comes.
I am a Perfect level now.
Shall I show you my attack?
I step back and press in again.
The fire in me burns stronger.
This wound only makes me hotter.

lines.zh: 我身上的红光暗了一瞬。
lines.en: My red dims for an instant.

lines.zh: 嘴角的血，我用爪背抹掉。
lines.en: I wipe the blood from my mouth with the back of my claw.

lines.zh: 是肉的味道，你放低了再给。
lines.en: The smell of meat — lower it before you give it.
One mouthful will not fill me.

lines.zh: 血腥味很新，谁刚伤过你？
lines.en: The blood smells fresh — who wounded you?
Three blocks of dragon, and I can carry you.
Two bites and it is gone.

lines.zh: 你把血擦掉，我不吃那种。
lines.en: Wipe the blood off. I will not eat that.
You hit me like a furnace wall.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲比你的武器硬。

lines.en: One shockwave and you stagger back.
A crack runs in the ground.

lines.zh: 我肩上的刃甲反着光，俯视你。
lines.en: Blade armor on my shoulders glints as I look down at you.

lines.zh: 这点冲量，连我的肩甲都推不动。
lines.en: That impact cannot even move my shoulder plate.
That is not in my thinking.

lines.zh: 你靠火太近，毛都要卷了。
lines.en: You stand too close to the fire; your hair will curl.
I turn my back on you.
There is nothing like that in me.
I pinch it up and it smokes.

lines.zh: 我这身红，是加速时烧起来的。
lines.en: This red of mine burns when I accelerate.
I tuck it behind my chest plate.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿烧不着，也砍不动。
lines.en: This thing will not burn and will not cut.
You are at the cliff edge.

lines.zh: 一步跨过山沟，我就到你面前。
lines.en: One stride across the ravine and I am before you.

lines.zh: 我这就下来，Hyper Heat 还没喷。
lines.en: I am coming down; Hyper Heat has not spat yet.

lines.zh: 这个角度，我的刃能劈到。
lines.en: From this angle, my blade can reach.

lines.zh: 牙露出来，山风都被烤热。
lines.en: My teeth show, and even the mountain wind grows hot.

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，我听得清楚。
lines.en: Your steps have lost their rhythm; I hear it clearly.

lines.zh: 一爪下去，地面焦黑一片。
lines.en: One slash, and the ground blackens.

lines.zh: 你砍在我肩甲上，弹开了。
lines.en: Your blow rings off my pauldron.
I come down the mountain path.
Red light hits the rock first.
The blades on my shoulders chime.
I crush the red rock underfoot.

lines.zh: 我这身装甲，一层压一层。

lines.en: I am at the bottom of the path.
Fire cannot hurt me. It only heats me.
I land and crater the ground.

lines.zh: 爆炸和我的火撞在一起。
弹头嵌在我胸前的刃上。
lines.en: A round sticks in my chest blade.
That light runs wild inside me.

lines.zh: 这里没有热，我冷得发僵。
lines.en: No heat here. I stiffen with cold.
